saints.name: St. Margaret Mary Alacoque
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: A Visitation nun of Paray-le-Monial to whom Christ revealed the riches of his Sacred Heart…
biography: Born in Burgundy in 1647, Margaret Mary entered the Visitation convent at Paray-le-Monial. There, between 1673 and 1675, she reported a series of revelations in which Christ showed her his Heart burning with love for humanity and asked for its devotion, for reparation, and for Communion on the First Fridays.

Her claims were met at first with distrust within her own community, but she found a defender in her confessor, the Jesuit St. Claude de la Colombière. Though she died in obscurity in 1690, the devotion to the Sacred Heart she promoted spread throughout the Church in the centuries after her death.
saints.knownFor: The revelations of the Sacred Heart of Jesus.
